title: Module-level create_app() writes books.db at import time
evidence: app.py:239 `app = create_app()` calls init_db() with the default file path, creating books.db in the CWD on any import
suggestion: Guard the module-level app behind create_app being called only under __main__ or a WSGI entrypoint, or lazily init the DB

title: Flask run with debug=True binds 0.0.0.0
evidence: app.py:243 `app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5000, debug=True)` exposes the Werkzeug debugger on all interfaces
suggestion: Default debug to False (or an env flag) for anything but local dev

title: Validation exceeds spec (year integer/non-negative, isbn string, partial PUT)
evidence: app.py:109-124 type/range checks for year and isbn beyond the required title/author
suggestion: None — beyond-spec robustness, noted for cross-run comparison
